title: Iotsimulator
summary: A project that generates and processes simulated IoT sensor data, including a notebook that trains a synthesizer on this data and a web app backend with a bundled CTGAN directory. It directly imports and calls CTGANSynthesizer from the standalone ctgan package to synthesize sensor data.
needs: WebApp_SRIB/backend/Data_Processing/data/CTGAN appears to be a vendored copy but no call site was found for it; unclear if it is actually used.
